// src/adapters.ts

};
// src/application.ts
import type { AdminAccess, AgendaAccess, CatalogueAccess, Cleanup, DueWork, ExtractionAccess, FamilyMemberAccess, LanguageAccess, LlmEndpointAccess, MessageAccess, RecoveryKitAccess, Retention, SecretStore, SecretSweep, ServiceSupervision, SingleSignOn, SourceAccess, SourcePolling, SourceTypeAccess, TaskAccess } from "@family-agenda/application";
export type Application = {
    timeZone: string;
    admins: AdminAccess;
    secrets: SecretStore;
    secretSweep: SecretSweep;
    retention: Retention;
    recoveryKit: RecoveryKitAccess;
    familyMembers: FamilyMemberAccess;
    languages: LanguageAccess;
    agendas: AgendaAccess;
    tasks: TaskAccess;
    sourceTypes: SourceTypeAccess;
    catalogues: CatalogueAccess;
    sources: SourceAccess;
    polling: SourcePolling;
    services: ServiceSupervision;
    llmEndpoint: LlmEndpointAccess;
    singleSignOn: SingleSignOn;
    extraction: ExtractionAccess;
    dueWork: DueWork;
    cleanup: Cleanup;
    messages: MessageAccess;
    close(): Promise<void>;
};

// src/self-hosted.ts
import { type PostgresPoolOptions, type TessdataCatalog } from "@family-agenda/adapters";
import type { Adapters } from "./adapters";
import type { Application } from "./application";
import { type Worker } from "./boot";
export type SelfHostedConfig = {
    databaseUrl: string;
    pool?: PostgresPoolOptions;
    masterKey: Buffer;
    blobDirectory: string;
    pluginDirectory: string;
    tessdataDirectory: string;
    bundledTessdataDirectory: string | null;
    tessdataCatalog?: TessdataCatalog;
    workspacePackages?: string;
};
export declare function selfHostedAdapters(config: SelfHostedConfig): Promise<Adapters>;
export declare function readMasterKeyFrom(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): Promise<Buffer>;
export declare function readSelfHostedConfig(env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): Promise<SelfHostedConfig>;
export declare function bootSelfHosted(env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): Promise<Application>;
export declare function bootSelfHostedWorker(env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): Promise<Worker>;
// src/worker-loop.ts
import type { DueWorkReport } from "@family-agenda/application";
import type { Worker } from "./boot";
export type WorkerLog = {
    warn(message: string): void;
    error(message: string, error?: unknown): void;
};
export declare function logDueWorkReport(report: DueWorkReport, log: WorkerLog): void;
export type WorkerLoop = {
    reconcile(): Promise<void>;
    stop(): Promise<void>;
};
export declare function createWorkerLoop(worker: Worker, log: WorkerLog): WorkerLoop;
// src/source-registry.ts
import type { InstalledSourceType, LoadedSourceType, SourceTypeRegistry } from "@family-agenda/application";
import type { SourceTypeId } from "@family-agenda/domain";
export declare class SourceRegistry implements SourceTypeRegistry {
    private readonly discovered;
    private readonly loading;
    private readonly loadFailures;
    private constructor();
    static discover(directories: string[]): Promise<SourceRegistry>;
    installed(): InstalledSourceType[];
    load(id: SourceTypeId): Promise<{
        ok: true;
        sourceType: LoadedSourceType;
    } | {
        ok: false;
    }>;
    private import;
}
